trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of the 4-sentence proposition plus its tikzcd. No negation-contrast, rhetorical pivot, em-dash, triple, closing aphorism (the block ends on a tikzcd), meta-commentary, thesis restatement, warmth, or non-speakable chain; 'entirely determining' is emphatic but is the actual mutual-determination claim, not superlative inflation.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: MATH FLAG (not a trap, reported not fixed): 'This assignment sigma : P(V) -> Ad(A) is an involution' is a category error as written. sigma is an EMBEDDING between two different objects (the block itself writes it with a hook arrow), so it cannot square to anything. What the supporting lemma and proof actually establish is that 2 sigma(rho) is an involution in End(V) - a different map. The intended sense appears to be that the fibre -> adjoint -> fibre round trip is the identity (which is what the block title 'Fiber-adjoint-fiber involution' and the following clause 'entirely determining P(V) from Ad(A) and vice versa' say). PROPOSED: 'This assignment sigma : P(V) -> Ad(A) is an embedding whose image determines P(V) from Ad(A) and conversely; the induced fibre-adjoint-fibre round trip is the identity.'
